title: Retention per data category and purpose (standards/privacy/retention.yaml)
description: One entry per data category and purpose (and, where an overlay differs, per jurisdiction): how long it is kept, the event that starts the clock, why that long in plain language, and the legal basis. Periods are set with legal advice (spec, Privacy: Retention). No entries means nothing is set yet: the notice refuses to render and no approval page is built. Replaces retention@1, whose fixed list of five nullable periods is kept in contracts/v1/ (decision 0010).

category.description: A data category id from setup.data_categories

jurisdiction.description: Absent for the base entry; present where an overlay needs a different rule

until_event.description: An event that ends retention, instead of a fixed period (e.g. deletion is requested)

starts.description: The event that starts the clock

reason.description: Why that long, in plain language, as the notice will say it

basis.description: GDPR Article 6(1) bases, plus disclosed-purpose: a CCPA business or commercial purpose disclosed at collection, used only by overlay profiles (validate refuses it in a base profile). Identical in jurisdiction, purposes and retention (a test pins the equality)
